app.name: Khizāna
app.tagline: Your maktabah: your books, their authors, and what you learn from them.

common.loadFailed: We couldn't load this. Please try again.
common.stale: This was changed on another device after you opened it. Load the latest version, then make your changes again.

home.title: Welcome
home.noAuthors: Add the authors of your books and they'll be listed here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.accountAbout: Language, email address, and deleting your account.
settings.securityAbout: Where you're signed in, and what has happened to your account.
settings.changePasswordAbout: Choose a new password and sign out other devices.
settings.twoFactorAbout: A code from an authenticator app when you sign in.
settings.passkeysAbout: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: There's nothing at this address. It may have been mistyped, or the page may have moved.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.lockoutHint: After several wrong attempts in a row, sign-in is paused for 15 minutes to protect your account.

secondStep.title: Two-step verification
secondStep.intro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
secondStep.hint: Lost your phone? Enter one of your recovery codes instead.
secondStep.startAgain: Sign in with a different account

register.title: Create an account
register.intro: We'll email you a link to confirm your account.
register.passwordHint: At least 15 characters. Try a phrase of a few words you'll remember.
register.checkInboxBody: If {{email}} can be used to register, we've sent it a link to confirm your account. The link expires in 24 hours.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.intro: Enter your account's email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.checkInboxBody: If {{email}} has an account, we've sent it a link to reset the password. The link expires in 1 hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.doneBody: For your safety, every device has been signed out. Sign in with your new password.
reset.invalidTitle: This link is invalid or has expired
reset.invalidBody: It may have been used already, or it's more than an hour old. You can ask for a new one.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.intro: Other devices signed in to your account will be signed out.
changePassword.doneBody: Other devices have been signed out. We've emailed you to confirm the change.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.intro: Signing in will also need a code from an authenticator app on your phone, so a stolen password alone isn't enough.
twoFactor.offBody: You'll need an authenticator app, such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Aegis or 2FAS.
twoFactor.step1: 1. Add your account to the app
twoFactor.step1Body: In your authenticator app, add an account and scan this QR code.
twoFactor.qrLabel: QR code to add Khizana to your authenticator app
twoFactor.manualKey: Can't scan it? Enter this key instead:
twoFactor.step2: 2. Enter the code the app shows
twoFactor.codesBody: If you lose your phone, each of these codes lets you sign in once. Save them somewhere safe, such as a password manager or a printed copy. They won't be shown again.
twoFactor.newCodesBody: Your current recovery codes will stop working. Confirm it's you to create new ones.
twoFactor.turnOffBody: Signing in will need only your password. Confirm with your password and a code from your app (or a recovery code).

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.intro: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN instead of your password. Passkeys can't be guessed, and they only work on this website, so they can't be phished.
passkeys.unsupported: This browser can't use passkeys. Try an up-to-date Chrome, Edge, Safari or Firefox.
passkeys.none: You haven't added a passkey yet.
passkeys.removeBody: Confirm with your password to remove “{{label}}”. It will stop working straight away.
passkeys.addBody: Give it a name, confirm with your password, then follow your browser's prompt.
passkeys.addedNotice: “{{label}}” was added. You can now use it to sign in.
passkeys.name: Name
passkeys.nameHint: So you can tell your passkeys apart, for example “Laptop” or “Phone”.

security.title: Security
security.intro: See where you're signed in and what has happened to your account recently. If anything looks wrong, sign that device out and change your password.
security.signedOutOthers: You were signed out everywhere else.
security.sessionGone: That device was already signed out.
security.activityIntro: The last 50 events from the past 90 days. Devices are described from what the browser reports, so treat them as a guide.

events.sign_in_password_and_code: Signed in with your password and a code
events.sign_in_failed_locked: A sign-in was refused while sign-in was paused
events.sign_in_failed_wrong_password_confirmati: A wrong password was entered to confirm a change
events.account_locked: Sign-in was paused for 15 minutes after 5 wrong passwords
events.second_step_failed: A wrong two-step verification code was entered
events.session_ended: {{device}} was signed out from this page
events.recovery_code_used: A recovery code was used ({{left}} left)
events.email_change_requested: A change of email to {{email}} was requested
events.registration_attempt: Someone tried to create an account with your email address

account.title: Account settings
account.languageBody: The language for this site and for the emails we send you.
account.languageSaved: Saved. Emails will come in this language.
account.emailIntro: We'll send a link to the new address; the change happens when you open it. We'll also tell your current address.
account.codeHint: Or one of your recovery codes.
account.emailSent: Check the inbox of {{email}} and open the link within an hour. Nothing changes until you do.
account.deleteIntro: This deletes your account and everything in it, straight away and for good. It can't be undone.
account.deleteUnderstood: I understand this can't be undone
account.deletedBody: Everything in it has been removed, and you've been signed out everywhere. We've sent a last email to confirm.

confirmEmail.successTitle: Your email address has been changed
confirmEmail.successBody: Sign in with the new address from now on. Other devices have been signed out.
confirmEmail.invalidBody: It may have expired, been used already, or been replaced by a newer link. You can ask for a new one from your account settings.

verify.invalidTitle: This link is invalid or has expired
verify.invalidBody: It may have been used already, or it's more than 24 hours old. You can register again to get a new link.
verify.errorTitle: We couldn't confirm your email just now

books.title: Books
books.intro: Every copy on your shelves, with its work and authors.
books.none: You haven't added any books yet.
books.deleteConfirm: Delete {{title}}? Its bookmark goes too. Benefits from it are kept. This can't be undone.
books.notFound: This book isn't in your library. It may have been deleted.

form.workEditHint: Changes here apply to every copy of this work.
form.existingWork: Another copy of a work you already have?
form.existingWorkHint: Search your works, or leave this empty and fill in the work below.
form.coverTitleHint: Only if it differs from the work's title, such as a commentary printed with it.
form.shelfHint: Where it is kept, such as "Study, case 2".
form.readingHint: Leave both empty if you have not started it.

authors.title: Authors
authors.intro: The authors of the books in your library.
authors.none: You haven't added any authors yet.
authors.loadFailed: We couldn't load this. Please try again.
authors.notFound: This author isn't in your library. It may have been deleted.
authors.stale: This author was changed on another device after you opened it. Load the latest version, then make your changes again.
authors.workedOut: CE years in brackets are worked out from the Hijri year.

form.namesHint: The name the author is best known by, such as البخاري or al-Bukhari. Fill in at least one.
form.moreNames: Full name, ism, kunya, laqab and nisba (optional)
form.ceHint: Optional: fill it in if your book gives one. Otherwise we show the CE years the Hijri year falls in.

birth.approximate: The year of birth is approximate

death.approximate: The year of death is approximate

places.title: Places
places.intro: Where the authors of your books were born and died, and where books were printed.

none.mine: You haven't added any places yet. The shared list has the best-known ones.

places.notFound: This place isn't in your library. It may have been deleted.
places.sharedNote: This place is on the shared list everyone starts with, so it can't be changed.
places.openMap: (opens a map in a new tab)

form.namesHint: The classical name first, such as القسطنطينية or Constantinople. Fill in at least one.
form.otherNamesHint: One per line, such as the modern name (إسطنبول). Up to 10.
form.positionHint: Optional: in decimal degrees, such as 21.4225 and 39.8262. South and west are negative.

sciences.title: Sciences
sciences.intro: The sciences (funūn) your books are filed under. Rename, add or delete them as you like.
sciences.none: You have no sciences. Add the first above.

picker.placeHint: Type a name to search your places and the shared list.
picker.authorHint: Type a name to search your authors.

errors.too_short: Your password must be at least 15 characters.
errors.compromised: This password has appeared in known data breaches. Please choose another.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.busy: We're busy right now. Please try again in a moment.
errors.request_too_large: What you sent is too large.
errors.network_error: We couldn't connect. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.invalid_credentials: The email or password is incorrect.
errors.signOutFailed: We couldn't sign you out. Please try again.
errors.invalid_code: That code didn't work. Check the app shows the code for Khizana, then try the newest code.
errors.sign_in_again: That took too long. Please sign in again.
errors.setup_not_started: Please start again: choose Turn on.
errors.passkey_cancelled: The passkey prompt was closed or timed out. Try again, or sign in with your password.
errors.passkey_failed: Your browser couldn't use a passkey. Try again, or sign in with your password.
errors.invalid_passkey: That passkey wasn't accepted. If you removed it from this account, sign in with your password.
errors.passkey_already_registered: This passkey is already added to your account.
errors.too_many_passkeys: You have the maximum of 10 passkeys. Remove one to add another.
errors.start_again: That took too long. Please try again.
errors.not_found: That passkey doesn't exist any more. Reload the page.
errors.name_required: Fill in the name in Arabic or in English.
errors.invalid_characters: This contains characters that can't be used, such as hidden text-direction marks.
errors.invalid_year: Check this year: it must be a whole number in a possible range, such as 256.
errors.before_birth: The year of death can't be before the year of birth.
errors.stale_version: This was changed on another device. Load the latest version, then try again.
errors.version_required: Please reload the page and try again.
errors.limit_reached: Your library has reached its limit for this. Delete something to add more.
errors.in_use: This is still used elsewhere in your library, so it can't be deleted. Remove it from those records first.
errors.conflict: That change couldn't be saved. Reload the page and try again.
errors.in_use_by: This is still used by {{uses}}, so it can't be deleted. Remove it from those first.
errors.read_only: This is on the shared list, so it can't be changed.
errors.already_used: You already have one with this name.
errors.too_many: There are too many. Remove some and try again.
errors.coordinates_incomplete: Fill in both the latitude and the longitude, or neither.
errors.invalid_coordinate: Check this: latitude is from -90 to 90, longitude from -180 to 180, such as 21.4225.
errors.unknown_place: That place isn't in your library any more. Choose another.
errors.title_required: Fill in the title in Arabic or in English.
errors.invalid_number: Check this number: it must be a whole number in a possible range.
errors.in_the_future: This date can't be in the future.
errors.invalid_date: Check this date: it must be after 1900.
errors.start_required: A book you finished needs the date you started it.
errors.before_start: The day you finished can't be before the day you started.
errors.invalid_amount: Check the price: a positive amount, such as 95.50, with no more decimal places than the currency has.
errors.invalid_currency: Choose a currency from the list.
errors.currency_required: Choose the currency of the price.
errors.amount_required: Fill in the price, or clear the currency.
errors.invalid_isbn: Check this ISBN: 10 or 13 digits with a correct check digit, as printed on the book.
errors.invalid_legal_deposit: Check this number: digits, "/" and "-" only, such as 2005/12345.
errors.invalid_language: Choose a language from the list.
errors.below_bookmark: The bookmark is in a later volume. Move it first.
errors.below_benefit: A benefit cites a later volume. Change it first.
errors.volume_required: This book is a set: say which volume.
errors.unknown_work: That work isn't in your library any more. Choose another.
errors.unknown_author: One of those authors isn't in your library any more. Take it out and try again.
errors.unknown_science: That science isn't in your list any more. Choose another.
errors.work_required: Choose a work you have, or fill in a new one.
errors.work_or_work_id: Choose a work you have, or fill in a new one, not both.
